workloads.name: tail-sum
workloads.source: let run = n => loop (i = 0, acc = 0) { switch i >= n { | true => acc | false => recur(i + 1, acc + i) } }
workloads.javascript: const run = n => { let acc = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) acc += i; return acc; };

workloads.name: optional-match
workloads.source:
type Row = { value?: number }
let read = (row: Row) => switch row.value { | Some(v) => v | None => 0 }
workloads.javascript: const read = row => { const v = row.value; return v != null ? v : 0; };
workloads.emitted: const read = (row) => (($optional) => { if ($optional != null) { const v = $optional; return v; } return 0; })(row.value);
workloads.driver: const run = rows => { let acc = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 1000000; i++) acc += read(rows[i % 256]); return acc; };

workloads.name: record-pipeline
workloads.source:
type Row = { id: number, active: bool, amount?: number }
let run = (rows: Array<Row>) => rows
  |> Array.filter((row: Row) => row.active)
  |> Array.dedupeBy((row: Row) => row.id)
  |> Array.map((row: Row) => switch row.amount { | Some(v) => v | None => 0 })
  |> Array.reduce((acc, amount) => acc + amount, 0)
